Telangana Students Face Drug Cases and Textbook Shortages

Students in Telangana are facing two significant issues this year: a high number of drug-related cases and a shortage of textbooks. Data indicates nearly 40 students are booked in drug cases monthly, while another report highlights that textbook availability is impacting intermediate students across the state. These challenges affect the academic environment and well-being of students in Telangana.
